format:

    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: mono
    type: report
    layout: compact
_quarto:

      extension-test:
        description: The compact report of the mono preset starts on page 1 with the title block, the abstract and the body.

    mcanouil-typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['mcanouil-document\(\s*"report",\s*"compact",\s*none']
